fusions.name: Hard Knock
fusions.desc: A head-butt that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Cornered Flurry
fusions.desc: Flaps and kicks in a ring, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health, and its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 9 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
